bibliographic-data.invention-title: CÂBLES ET CÂBLES SYNTHÉTIQUES À HAUTE RÉSISTANCE
A PROCESS FOR ASCERTAINING THE ELONGATION OF A LOAD-BEARING CABLE

abstract.p: A synthetic rope or cable having a supportive core (1) contained within an internal cavity of a hollow braided synthetic strength member (5), the supportive core (1) shaped to adapt to the internal cavity of the hollow braided synthetic strength member (5), the supportive core (1) sheathed within a flow shield (4); the hollow braided synthetic strength member (5) formed about the combination of the supportive core and the flow shield that sheaths the core; the flow shield formed of the braid strands and being a hollow braided construction; and the hollow synthetic strength member formed of the braided braid strands, characterized in that each braid strand forming a braided flow shield is formed of at least two yarns.
